tools.name: stillindexed_check_url
tools.description: Fetch one URL and report HTTP status, redirect chain, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, canonical, title, H1, and whether it is indexable. Same check as https://stillindexed.com/tools/indexability-checker.

tools.name: stillindexed_bulk_check
tools.description: Indexability check for up to 20 URLs in one call. Order preserved. Invalid URLs become per-row errors; HTTP status stays 200. Counts against the 60 fetches/hour budget, one per URL.

tools.name: stillindexed_check_robots
tools.description: Validate a robots.txt with RFC 9309 and Google's parsing rules. Give url to fetch the live file, or content to test a pasted one, plus proposed to diff a second version. For each path or URL (up to 100, or use_sitemap to read them from the file's Sitemap line) it reports allowed or blocked for Googl

tools.name: stillindexed_check_sitemap
tools.description: Fetch a sitemap (or the host's /sitemap.xml) and report status, XML validity, and URL count.

tools.name: stillindexed_check_tls
tools.description: TLS certificate for the host: days remaining, chain validity, hostname match.

tools.name: stillindexed_check_domain
tools.description: Domain registration expiry via RDAP. Many ccTLDs have no RDAP; the tool says so instead of inventing an expiry.

tools.name: stillindexed_crawler_diff
tools.description: Fetch the same URL as Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot and a browser, then compare status, indexability directives and content. Costs 4 fetches.

tools.name: stillindexed_check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Check robots.txt for the 13 tracked AI crawlers (ChatGPT search, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini grounding, and the training crawlers) and report, per crawler, whether the given URL's path is allowed or blocked, naming the deciding group and rule. Also probes the edge once as each of the three AI search

tools.name: stillindexed_generate_seo_skill
tools.description: Fetch the URL, robots.txt, sitemap (with index expansion), host variants, a four-persona crawler diff and TLS, then return a SKILL.md an agent can install for that host. Up to 12 fetches. Same generator as https://stillindexed.com/tools/seo-skill-generator.

tools.name: stillindexed_deindex_triage
tools.description: Triage a domain that disappeared from Google. Checks nine causes in crawl-then-index order (domain registration via RDAP, TLS certificate, robots.txt status, robots.txt rule for the homepage, homepage status as Googlebot vs a browser, redirects off the domain, noindex in meta or X-Robots-Tag, canoni

tools.name: stillindexed_sitemap_audit
tools.description: Audit a sitemap: pass a sitemap URL, or a hostname to use the sitemap robots.txt declares. Samples up to 200 listed URLs (evenly across the file; up to 5 children of a sitemap index), fetches each with the stillindexedbot user agent, and flags non-200, redirected, noindex, blocked by robots.txt for

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "stillindexed_check_robots" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch robots.txt for the host and report the effective allow/disallow for each path, wildcard group vs Googlebot separately." → after: "Validate a robots.txt with RFC 9309 and Google's parsing rules. Give url to fetch the live file, or content to test a pasted one, plus proposed to diff a second version. For each path or URL (up to 100, or use_sitemap to read them from the file's Sitemap line) it reports allowed or blocked for Googl"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
